d: Chief of Defence Staff General N. S. Raja Subramani outlines seven key expectations for the Indian defence industry, calling on domestic manufacturers to own designs, secure intellectual property, and develop robust local vendor bases. Warning that dependency on foreign original equipment manufacturers creates long-term technological vulnerabilities, he highlights the strategic necessity of Atmanirbharta, surge production capabilities, and substantial corporate investment in research and development.
